text:
lina: Observed a ~20% tokens/sec drop on the continuous-batcher after the scheduler merge (commit 4f2b9c3). Perf dashboard: https://perf.internal/runs/17678 :eyes:
ben: saw it too on a 16xA100 pool. Latency p99 up ~30ms, throughput down.
akiko: CI flagged a regression on the integration perf job earlier: `perf/regression: runtime/scheduler tokens/sec -22%` — attaching logs.
ci-bot: build 4821 | perf/regression detected | repo: inference-runtime | test: scheduler_throughput | delta: -22% | link: https://ci.internal/4821
lina: I ran `git bisect` locally. First bad commit points at 4f2b9c3 -> changes to scheduler: introduce token_budget control + kernel chooser refactor.
mike: can you paste the small perf profile? especially scheduler queue times and batch formation histograms.
lina: quick profile snippet:
```
Scheduler::enqueue_wait_ms: median=1.2, p95=34.8, p99=128.4
BatchMaker::emit_interval_ms: median=2.0, p95=200.3, p99=420.1
KVCache::hit_rate: 87%
Tokens/sec (before): 120k
Tokens/sec (after): 94k
```
akiko: BatchMaker p99 420ms is wild. Suggests long tail queuing rather than kernel slowness.
ben: I think the token_budget change reduces early batch flushes; longer waits try to grow batches but under skewed load they stall. That would increase latency and reduce tokens/sec.
lina: Reproduced with loadgen: when we enable `scheduler.token_budget=adaptive` we see fewer small batches but many large batches wait for a straggler and time out -> fewer effective tokens/sec.
mike: Could be interaction with kernel_selector: if the chooser now prefers int8 kernels but they have higher per-batch setup cost on A100 when batch size changes.
ben: Good point. Any kernel start-up time in traces?
lina: Start-up trace shows kernel swap/setup time ~18ms for mixed-precision switch. When a large batch arrives after waiting, we see this often.
akiko: Quick mitigation: roll back token_budget to `fixed=8` to restore previous flushing behavior, OR reduce `max_wait_ms` from 200 to 50.
lina: I opened a rollback PR for the scheduler token_budget change: PR #1789. Also raising a follow-up to add a canary test exercising skewed load patterns.
deploy-bot: PR 1789 deployed to staging (canary) on pool: staging-16xA100 at 2026-03-18T15:42Z
ben: staging perf after rollback (canary) looks back to baseline: tokens/sec ~118k, p99 latency within 5ms of previous.
akiko: We should add a micro-benchmark that runs kernel selection hot path with small/large batch churn.
mike: Agreed. Also record KVCache hit behavior per batch size to verify caching impact.
lina: Notes: bisect -> 4f2b9c3 (scheduler token_budget + kernel chooser refactor). Immediate fix: rollback token_budget change (PR 1789) and follow-up: tune `max_wait_ms` + add targeted CI perf test.
ben: thanks — I'll monitor rollout. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: perf check on staging canary passed for rollback (build 4825) | delta: +1% tokens/sec
lina: closing the thread after the rollback stabilizes, will post the full perf report tomorrow with flamegraphs.
